Controls

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. To pit, steer into the marked pit entry: the car drives itself to its box, where you choose tyres and fuel. Gamepad: left stick steers, RT throttle, LT brake, Start pauses.
Accelerate W↑
Brake S↓
Steer AD←→
Controlled drift W + S + A/D
Launch (hold on the grid) W
Look back B
Tyres & pit info V
Telemetry graph T
Respawn on track RSpace
Mute audio M
Pause Esc
